item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence for one-off corrective actions and personnel replacement, but not for a broad pattern of repeated successful course-correction across the whole government in 2024.\nI also did not find evidence that Scholz systematically replaced multiple ineffective implementers beyond the Lindner-to-Kukies switch.\nThe late-year collapse means the best-supported reading is: he did adapt, but the adaptation was too late or too limited to preserve effective control.","evidence":[{"title":"Scholz fires Lindner and moves to a new finance minister.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"6 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936","summary":"When coalition bargaining over the budget failed, Scholz dismissed Finance Minister Christian Lindner and effectively reset the cabinet, which is direct evidence of replacing an ineffective implementer rather than simply absorbing the failure.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"Scholz appoints Jörg Kukies, a seasoned technocrat, to replace Lindner.","publisher":"Euronews","date":"7 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/11/07/scholz-names-finance-minister-amid-germanys-ruling-coalition-crisis-reports-claim","summary":"The replacement was framed as a close adviser but also an experienced policy official, which supports a reading of tactical repair through a technically competent substitute, not pure patronage.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"Scholz and his coalition partners settle on a 2025 budget plus growth initiative after difficult negotiations.","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"5 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116","summary":"The government says it reached a compromise after tough talks and translated it into a concrete package with 49 measures, tax relief, infrastructure, social housing, security spending, and Ukraine support. This is evidence of adjusting methods and reallocating resources to keep the program moving.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"Scholz backs a first-ever cross-government evaluation of Bundeswehr overseas missions and accepts specific improvements.","publisher":"Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence","date":"26 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958","summary":"The report uses uniform criteria to review seven missions and explicitly recommends better civilian-military coordination, more realistic goals, and more flexible, scalable options. This is strong evidence of correcting course after mixed results.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"Scholz supports an AI Act compromise after internal coalition resistance.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"30 Jan 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/germany-will-approve-eus-planned-ai-act--sources-3286730","summary":"Reuters reports that coalition objections were resolved and Germany moved to back the EU AI Act, showing negotiated adaptation rather than policy paralysis on a sensitive file.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"Germany phases out Huawei and ZTE from 5G core networks on a fixed timetable.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"11 Jul 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/tech/germany-agrees-phaseout-of-huawei-zte-components-in-5g-core-network/2170329/","summary":"The government completes contracts to remove risky components and gives operators a deadline, which is a concrete resource and method adjustment in response to security concerns.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"Scholz publicly commits to a constitutional route out of the coalition crisis.","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"13 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2320314","summary":"He says he dismissed Lindner, that the decision was unavoidable, and that he would seek a confidence vote so citizens could decide in new elections. This is a corrective move, but it also shows the limits of his control.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"The coalition collapse is strong evidence that correction failed to preserve effective control.","publisher":"Reuters","date":"6 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936","summary":"Scholz’s dismissal of Lindner did not stabilize the coalition; it triggered political chaos and minority-rule uncertainty. This is direct counterevidence against sustained corrective success.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"Scholz loses the December confidence vote, confirming end-stage loss of parliamentary control.","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"16 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198","summary":"Parliament withdraws confidence by a wide margin, showing that whatever corrective steps existed, they did not restore durable governing authority by year-end.","question_ids":["8B.8"]},{"title":"The BND surveillance ruling shows unresolved structural weakness in control and oversight.","publisher":"Bundesverfassungsgericht","date":"8 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html","summary":"The court finds parts of the surveillance framework unconstitutional and says independent oversight is inadequate. This is not proof Scholz caused the defect, but it is relevant negative evidence for the claim that his system corrected course cleanly.","question_ids":["8B.8"]}]}
